'''Rogwa Wodrata''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Holwuff/Legends|Holwuff]] who represented her [[Homeworld/Legends|home]]<ref name="Databank" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Alliga]] in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Databank" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Wodrata participated at the summit on the planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] held by the Separatist leader [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], sitting between [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] and [[Po Nudo/Legends|Po Nudo]].<ref name="AOTC" /> She continued to represent Alliga during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="Databank" /> that [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|erupted]] shortly afterwards. Wodrata had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]] and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rogwa Wodrata was created to replace the character [[Toonbuck Toora/Legends|Toonbuck Toora]] in the [[2002]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="Insider65">{{InsiderCite|65|Star Wars Q&A|''Star Wars'' Q&A}}</ref><ref name="SWCTP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> Toora was originally present during filming of the Separatist council scene,<ref name="SWCTP" /><ref name="Insider65" /> She was practical alien originally built for the Senate scenes in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace]], was present during filming of ''Attack of the Clones''<ref name="SWCTP" /> but during post-production, director [[George Lucas]] was unsatisfied with the lack of expression or menace in her mask and decided to replace her with Wodrata.<ref>{{SWArchive|url=qa|text=''Star Wars'' Q & A}} - Episode II Lore - February 07, 2003</ref><ref name="Insider65" /><ref name="SWCTP" /><ref name="Insider101">{{InsiderCite|101|Ask Lobot}}</ref> According to the website Avleyman the character was played by [[Hilton Howson]].<ref name="Aveleyman">{{WebCite|url=https://www.aveleyman.com/ActorCredit.aspx?ActorID=76971|text=Aveleyman &ndash; Hilton Howson|work=[http://www.aveleyman.com Aveleyman.com]|archivedate=20181105143534}}</ref> Rogwa's head, nicknamed 'Gatorhead' by [[Industrial Light & Magic]] was a retooled alien Jedi design that was composited over Toonbuck Toora.<ref name="SWCTP" /><ref name="Insider65" /> In [[Star Wars Insider 101]], [[Leland Chee]] stated that there had been some suggestion about the Toonbuck Toora seen on Geonosis may have actually been a [[Shi'ido]] shapeshifter, part of a deceptive scheme to align [[Sy Myrth]] with the Confederacy, but ultimately fails leaving the planet faithful to the republic.<ref name="Insider101" />
